capabilities: edit Markdown notes as interactive mind maps with drag-and-drop and WYSIWYG preview
convert between Markdown and XMind formats with round-trip fidelity
apply XMind layout skeletons, color themes, and frontmatter styling
run an AI copilot drawer with skills for outlines, wikis, and diagrams
export mind maps as high-resolution PNG, JPEG, SVG, and documents
extras: Freemium: core features are free with a 7-day full trial and optional activation codes for advanced AI extensions. Native .xmind binary parsing and web_fetch are desktop-only due to mobile sandbox limits. Recommended installation is via the BRAT plugin. Includes 10 built-in skills unpacked to a vault skills/ directory plus 6 bundled extension skills.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in mind map view and no way to open or edit XMind files alongside Markdown notes.
